Installation

pyStarburst99 can be installed by cloning the GitHub repository:

git clone https://github.com/CalumHawcroft/Starburst.git
cd Starburst
pip install .

To also install the optional dependencies:

pip install ".[full]"

You can also run pyStarburst99 in your browser, with no installation, using this Colab notebook. The runtime is longer than with a local installation.

Core dependencies

  • Numpy – Array operations

  • Pandas – Reading the spectral libraries

  • Scipy – Interpolation and fitting

  • Matplotlib – Plotting the results

Optional dependencies

  • tqdm – Progress bars in the terminal and notebooks (a plain text bar is used without it)

Updating pyStarburst99

To upgrade to the latest version, pull the latest changes and reinstall:

git pull
pip install .

Uninstalling

pip uninstall pystarburst99

For developers

The following command installs the dependencies to compile the documentation and run the tests:

pip install ".[docs,tests]"

pyStarburst99 has been tested with Python 3.12. See the pyproject.toml in the repository for the most up-to-date build and dependency information.
